title: 第7章 瓦里安乌瑞恩第8章 我们中出了一个叛徒
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 艾伦比较关心自己有没有把那封信救回来。
温雷好似早就猜到一般，将几乎被烧毁的碎纸片递给他，
“内容基本都被烧光了，只剩下这个抬头……”
艾伦接过，只见信纸只剩了一个霉黑的角，勉强能辨认出上面优雅的花体字：
“致德·蒙莫朗西先生……”
【支线任务解锁】
【支线任务名称：德·蒙莫朗西之谜
奇怪的信，奇怪的徽记，奇怪的诅咒，这其中藏着秘密，尝试弄清楚德·蒙莫朗西家族之谜。
任务奖励：1个随机低环法术、敏捷属性点5点】
德·蒙莫朗先生是谁呢？魔兽世界游戏里有这个人吗？
现在可以确定的是，狮王之傲诡异的雨夜事件应该和这封信所召唤出来的怨灵脱不了关系。
可那天夜里见到的六个淋湿的小孩又是怎么回事，听到的诱惑低语又是怎么回事？
艾伦开始沉思，手不自觉伸向众人。
其余人不明白艾伦伸手出来要干什么，纷纷转头看向他的亲随，温雷大叔。
温雷眉头隐隐跳了一下，然后咳嗽了一声，“怎么了？”
“给我纸和笔。”
见到艾伦如此自然地使唤起自己，温雷面无表情的脸下已经透出淡淡的寒意，但他还是转身从行囊中翻出一沓空白的羊皮纸和一支蘸水笔，递了过去。
艾伦随手几笔，画下了一个流着泪的竖瞳眼睛，分外邪异。那眼睛仿佛带着某种诡异的生命力，在纸面上直直地盯着人看。
“你们认得这个标记吗？这是画在信封上的徽记。”
众人围过来端详片刻，纷纷摇头，表示从未见过这个徽记。
法雷倒是想起了什么，
“虽然没见过这个徽记，但我听说过德·蒙莫朗西这个姓氏，是来自暴风城的贵族。不过他们比较神秘，也不怎么在公众面前露面。”
温雷则有别的发现，“虽然只剩了一角，但这封信上有很明显的死灵魔法的痕迹。”
斯黛拉见自己在这帮不上忙，转眼间一溜烟跑到楼下不知道忙啥去了。
又说了几句，法雷随便找了个理由支开了他的伙计，搓着手，不好意思地看向艾伦。
“这个，尊贵的普瑞斯托先生，虽然很感激您破除了旅馆的诅咒，但是这个……但您的手下一箭差点把旅馆烧了，这…这多……”
法雷看着艾伦，艾伦只能瞪着个大眼睛，无辜地看着温雷。
温雷还在仔细钻研着艾伦画下的那只眼睛，随手拿出了一个小袋子。
丁零当啷的，光是听到里面清脆的声音，法雷的眼睛都亮了，
“多……多好啊！射的多好啊！英雄！勇士！好！感谢您拯救了狮王之傲！”
法雷收下小袋子一掂就掂出了大概的数额，然后心满意足地离开了房间，也带走了艾伦的视线。
这得有多少钱啊？
看着艾伦的眼神，温雷突然开口，“实话实说吧，我就是来追查这些的，如果可以的话，我希望你能陪着我去一趟暴风城，我需要你的配合，来帮助我继续调查。”
艾伦想了想，虽然自己触发了相关的任务，也需要调查这件事情，但无缘无故这么热心帮忙，也显得很可疑吧？
别误会，这可不是因为他贪财，这只是为了给自己一个表面上合理又不让人怀疑的行动诱因。
所以他举起手，大拇指和食指搓了搓，然后比出了一个五的手势，“五……”
他话还没说完，温雷已经斩钉截铁地同意了他的要求，“五金就五金，这一个金币是定金，事成之后，我会再给你四个金币。”
艾伦愣了一下，5个金币？可是我本来想说的是50个银币啊？
虽说如此，他还是毫不犹豫地接过温雷抛向他的一个金币，那枚金灿灿的钱币在空中划过一道完美的弧线，稳稳落入掌心，沉甸甸的触感让艾伦心花怒放。
他脱口而出，“成交！”
一辆马车行驶在林荫大道上，四周是静谧的森林和清脆的的莺啼声。
马车内，艾伦看着张着湛蓝色大眼睛望着他的斯黛拉，发出了灵魂疑问，
“她怎么会在这里？”

Allen was more concerned about whether he had rescued the letter.
Wen Lei seemed to have guessed it a long time ago and handed him the almost burned pieces of paper.
"The content has basically been burned away, leaving only this header..."
Allen took it and saw that only a moldy black corner of the letter was left, and he could barely make out the elegant cursive characters on it:
"To Monsieur de Montmorency..."
[Side Mission Unlocked]
[Side mission name: The Mystery of De Montmorency
Strange letters, strange emblems, strange curses, there are secrets hidden in them, try to figure out the mystery of the de Montmorency family.
Mission reward: 1 random low-level spell, 5 agility attribute points]
Who is M. de Montmorand? Is this person in the World of Warcraft game?
What is certain now is that the strange rainy night incident in the Pride of the Lion King should be inseparable from the resentful spirit summoned by this letter.
But what about the six wet children I saw that night, and what about the seductive whispers I heard?
Allen began to think deeply, and his hands unconsciously reached out to everyone.
The rest of the people didn't understand what Allen was doing with his hand, and they all turned to look at his personal attendant, Uncle Wen Lei.
Wen Lei's brows twitched slightly, then coughed, "What's wrong?"
"Give me paper and pen."
Seeing Allen arouse himself so naturally, Wen Lei's expressionless face already showed a slight chill, but he still turned around and took out a stack of blank parchment and a dip pen from his bag and handed them over.
With a few random strokes, Allen drew a tearful eye with vertical pupils, which was particularly evil. Those eyes seemed to have some strange vitality, staring straight at the person on the paper.
"Do you recognize this mark? It's the emblem painted on the envelope."
Everyone gathered around to look at it for a moment, then shook their heads, saying that they had never seen this emblem before.
Farley remembered something,
"Although I have never seen this emblem, I have heard of the surname de Montmorency, who is a noble from Stormwind City. However, they are relatively mysterious and do not appear in public very often."
Wen Lei made other discoveries, "Although only a corner is left, there are obvious traces of necromancy magic on this letter."
Seeing that she couldn't help here, Stella ran downstairs in a blink of an eye and didn't know what she was busy with.
After saying a few more words, Farley found a reason to send his guy away, rubbed his hands, and looked at Allen sheepishly.
"Well, distinguished Mr. Presto, although I am very grateful to you for breaking the curse of the hotel, but this... but one of your men almost burned down the hotel with one arrow. This... this is so..."
Farley looked at Allen, and Allen could only stare at Wen Lei innocently with his big eyes.
Wen Lei was still studying the eye drawn by Allen carefully, and casually took out a small bag.
There was a tinkling sound, and Farley's eyes lit up just by hearing the crisp sound inside.
"How...so good! What a nice shot! Hero! Warrior! Good! Thank you for saving the Lion's Pride!"
Farley took the small bag and weighed it out to find out the approximate amount, and then left the room with satisfaction, taking away Allen's sight.
How much does this cost?
Looking at Allen's eyes, Wen Lei suddenly said, "To be honest, I am here to track down these. If possible, I hope you can accompany me to Stormwind City. I need your cooperation to help me continue the investigation."
Allen thought for a while. Although he had triggered the relevant tasks and needed to investigate the matter, it seemed suspicious to be so eager to help for no reason, right?
Don't get me wrong, this is not because he is greedy for money, it is just to give himself a seemingly reasonable and unsuspecting inducement to act.
So he raised his hand, rubbed his thumb and index finger together, and then made a five sign, "Five..."
Before he finished speaking, Wen Lei had already categorically agreed to his request, "Five gold coins are just five gold coins. This gold coin is a deposit. After the matter is completed, I will give you four more gold coins."
Allen was stunned for a moment, 5 gold coins? But what I originally wanted to say was 50 silver coins?
Even so, he still took a gold coin thrown to him by Wen Lei without hesitation. The golden coin drew a perfect arc in the air and fell steadily into his palm. The heavy touch made Allen elated.
He blurted out, "Deal!"
---------------
A carriage was driving on the boulevard, surrounded by the quiet forest and the crisp chirping of warblers.
In the carriage, Allen looked at Stella who was looking at him with big blue eyes, and asked questions about his soul,
"Why is she here?"
